official_definition: You can summon this Spirit card from your Hand by using 20px from the Reserve to pay the entire summon cost and cores from the Reserve to put onto it.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Soul Swift] or [Soul Swift: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Soul Swift]", "give [Soul Swift]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
